Everflowing Chalice: Blink removes charge counters; it returns with zero unless another effect supplies them. Copies likewise do not copy its counters.
Replicating Ring: Blink removes night counters and delays its eight-counter payoff.
Kaalia of the Vast: Put from hand, not cast. Requires declaring Kaalia as an attacker against an opponent and an eligible creature in hand.
Silence: Stops future casts for the turn. Does not counter spells already on the stack or stop activated/triggered abilities.
Orim's Chant: Stops the targeted player from casting; kicked mode also stops attacks. Not a counter to a spell already cast.
Venser, the Sojourner: Removal coverage requires the -8 emblem and later spell casts. +2 blink is own-permanent reuse, not an immediate opposing-permanent answer.
Teferi, Hero of Dominaria: Ordinary -3 reaches nonlands; land-exile coverage requires the -8 emblem and subsequent draws.
Shadowspear: Can remove hexproof and indestructible from opposing permanents. Does not remove shroud and is not removal by itself.
Aether Vial: Uses the number of charge counters as an exact mana-value match for a creature in hand. This puts the creature onto the battlefield without casting it.
Windbrisk Heights: The hidden card is accessible only if you attacked with three or more creatures this turn and can pay the activation cost.
Snapcaster Mage: Grants flashback to an instant or sorcery in your graveyard until end of turn. You still pay the flashback cost and follow the spell's timing restrictions.
Sun Titan: An entry or attack can return a permanent card with mana value three or less. It does not recover instants or sorceries.
Force of Will: The alternate payment requires a life and another blue card from hand. It avoids the mana cost, not the exchange of cards.
Kenrith, the Returned King: Kenrith must be on the battlefield to activate his abilities. Reanimation costs 4B, needs a creature card in a graveyard, and returns it under its owner's control.
Sneak Attack: Pay R and have a creature card in hand. It enters without being cast, gains haste and is sacrificed at the next end step.
Living Death: Everyone exiles creature cards from their graveyards first, then sacrifices their creatures, then returns the exiled cards. Newly sacrificed creatures do not come back from this spell.
Tocasia's Welcome: A creature of mana value three or less entering under your control can draw a card only once each turn. Multiple entries in the same turn cannot repeatedly draw.
Reanimate: Returns a creature from a graveyard under your control; you lose life equal to its mana value.
Sevinne's Reclamation: Requires a permanent card of mana value three or less in your own graveyard. Its copy option requires casting Reclamation from a graveyard.
The One Ring: Its tap ability adds a burden counter before drawing for each counter. Repeated draw increases the life loss at upkeep.
Skullclamp: An equipped creature must die for the two cards. Exiling it is not dying; equip also needs mana and normally sorcery timing.
